proxyToGM.name: Proxy To Active GM
proxyToGM.hint: If enabled, non-GM clients send roll events to the active GM for automation.

autoScrollTargets.name: Auto-Scroll Target Helper
autoScrollTargets.hint: When chat is already at the bottom, keep it pinned when Target Helper expands a message.

debugBridge.name: Bridge Debug Logging
debugBridge.hint: Client-side debug logging for bridge patches (scope inheritance, suppression, and linked-cast bypass decisions).

itemActivationsRuFix.name: PF2e Item Activations RU Fix
itemActivationsRuFix.hint: Optional compatibility patch: fix generated action type and frequency for Russian activation text.

itemActivationsAutoSelfEffect.name: PF2e Item Activations Auto-Link Self Effect
itemActivationsAutoSelfEffect.hint: Optional compatibility patch: link selfEffect from description only when one safe effect UUID is found.

targetHelperActionRowsFix.name: Applied Label Layout Fix
targetHelperActionRowsFix.hint: Optional compatibility patch: keep Applied/effect-applied labels readable instead of vertical text.

forceBarrageTargetDialogBridge.name: Macro Target Dialog Enhancer
forceBarrageTargetDialogBridge.hint: Optional UI patch: in macro target distribution dialogs, show token portrait, duplicate-name numbering, and hover-highlight/click-focus helpers.

forceBarrageDialogMatchMode.name: Target Dialog Match Mode
forceBarrageDialogMatchMode.hint: Safe mode uses strict target-label checks; aggressive mode applies enhancement to any matching number-distribution target dialog.

baneAuraVisualRefresh.name: Bane Aura Visual Auto-Refresh
baneAuraVisualRefresh.hint: Optional compatibility patch: when Bane aura badge changes, debounce-restart its Active Effect animation so visual radius follows mechanical badge/radius updates.

baneAuraVisualGrowBy5Experimental.name: Bane Aura In-Place +5ft (Experimental)
baneAuraVisualGrowBy5Experimental.hint: Optional compatibility patch (experimental): on Bane badge updates, try resizing existing Sequencer aura by +5 ft in place (clears duplicate overlays); if it fails, fall back to full restart. Requires Bane Aura Visual Auto-Refresh.

toolbeltMacroScopeBridge.name: Toolbelt Nested Macro Scope Bridge
toolbeltMacroScopeBridge.hint: Optional compatibility patch: nested script macros inherit Toolbelt spell scope (cast/options), including async compendium-link wrappers, so linked casts keep slot/charge behavior.

toolbeltSpellCastLinkedBypass.name: Toolbelt Spell Cast Linked-Macro Bypass
toolbeltSpellCastLinkedBypass.hint: Optional compatibility patch: when a linked spell macro internally casts, bypass one recursive linked-macro pass and suppress one actionable linked lookup to prevent duplicate dialogs and preserve slot/charge consumption.
